verses.1: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants what must happen in the future. He also sent his messenger to his servant John.
verses.2: He who testified to the words of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, everything he saw.
verses.3: Those who listened to the words of prophecy and took note of what was written in them, indeed, had the right time at hand.
verses.4: John’s seven assemblies in Asia. May peace and goodwill be with you, from the one who is and has always been, and from those seven spirits before His throne.
verses.5: And from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the first among the dead, and the ruler of all kings on earth. He who loves us and saves us from our sins in his own blood.
verses.6: And he created us for his kingdom, for the priests of the God and their father. To him belongs glory and rule throughout all ages. Amen.
verses.7: Look! He is coming along with clouds in his wake. Everyone’s eyes will see him, and all the plants on earth will be destroyed by him. Yes, that’s true.
verses.8: “I am Alpha and Omega,” says the Lord, God, the One who was, is, and will be. He is the Almighty.
verses.9: I am John, your brother and companion in sorrow, in joy, and in patience with Jesus. I came to this island called Patmos because of the word of God and because of the testimony of Jesus.
verses.10: I was created in the breath of that day of creation. I heard a loud voice coming from behind me, like the sound of a trumpet.
verses.11: It is said that when you see someone writing something down in a book, send those writings to the seven churches: Ephesus, Syria, Perga, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.
verses.12: And I was able to see again that voice that had been lost along with me. And when I returned, I saw seven golden lychaeas.
verses.13: And in the middle of those lychnoi, there was a human-like child, dressed in shoes and surrounded by a golden belt.
verses.14: And his head and his white hair were like white wool; his eyes were like flames of fire.
verses.15: And his feet were like those of a bronze statue; they were as hot as if they had been heated in fire. And his voice was like the sound of many waters.
verses.16: And he had seven stars in his right hand. From his mouth, a sharp spear was being drawn out. His appearance resembled the sun, as it shines in its power.
verses.17: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as if he were dead. He placed his right hand on me and said, “Do not fear. I am the first and the last.”
verses.18: And I, who am alive—yet I have become dead. Yet I still exist for those who live in the ages to come. I possess the bonds of death and oblivion.
verses.19: Therefore, write down what you have seen, what exists already, and what will happen in the future.
verses.20: The mystery of the seven stars that you saw on my right side, and also those seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the messengers of the seven churches; and those seven lampstands represent the seven churches themselves.
